instructions_to_main_agent: FORCE DARK MODE: Ensure the app is always in dark mode. Add 'dark' class to the html or body tag by default.
USE SHADCN: Use the existing shadcn components in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/ but CUSTOMIZE them via Tailwind classes to match the 'Obsidian' palette.
NO GRADIENT TEXT: Do not use gradient text for headings unless it's the main hero title. Keep it legible.
DATA VIZ: Use Recharts for charts. Style them to match the dark theme (dark tooltips, neon lines).
AI SECTION: Highlight the AI analysis section with a subtle purple glow (secondary color) to differentiate it from standard logs.
PDF EXPORT: Ensure the report page is printer-friendly or has a specific print stylesheet/component for PDF generation.
universal_guidelines: Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
